checkpoints.description: [1/3] Cache immutable CPU topology in systemInfo and re-measure the app's health/metrics routes; no tuning

impact_assessment.why: User directive to continue improving ModelDuck speed; measured os.cpus() at 347us per call and systemInfo() at 345us, called on /api/health, /api/metrics and every fingerprint resolution
impact_assessment.benefits: Free-memory and uptime stay live while CPU model/core reads become O(1); lower latency on frequently polled routes
impact_assessment.risks: contract: systemInfo's returned shape and values must stay identical; dependency: Node stdlib only; concurrency: cached topology is immutable; state: no settings, prompts, generation or suite hashes change
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first test pinning one CPU read, compare fields before/after, run npm test and project gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [3/3] DELIVERED: systemInfo 345.5us -> 1.3us (~265x) via one-time CPU topology read; server startup no longer imports the benchmark suite (task ids split into task-ids.mjs); npm test 1100 tests pass, check --strict 4/4 gates green
Task 'app-speed-wave2' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Memoize the static task-subset hash and re-measure /api/recommendations; no tuning

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving project speed; measured taskSubsetHash at 1.79ms per call and /api/recommendations at 18.76ms with 8 models because each fingerprint recomputed the same suite hash
impact_assessment.benefits: One hash of the frozen prompt suite per process instead of one per model per request
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the returned hash must be byte-identical; dependency: Node crypto only; concurrency: memoized value is immutable; state: no prompts, checks, suite version, settings or generation change
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first test pinning one computation, verify hash parity with the uncached path, run npm test and project gates before commit

checkpoints.description: [3/3] DELIVERED: taskSubsetHash 1.79ms -> ~0.00ms; /api/recommendations 18.76ms -> 5.12ms with 8 models; byte-parity test, npm test 1103 tests pass, strict gates 4/4

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Speed tuning/engine tests without running a whole tune: make a failed llama-server spawn refuse immediately instead of waiting the 5s exit timeout

impact_assessment.why: User directive to look at tuning speed via tests only; TAP profile showed one engine test taking 5131ms because stop() waited 5s for an exit event that a failed spawn never emits
impact_assessment.benefits: Immediate actionable failure for a missing engine binary in the app, and a ~20% faster full test suite
impact_assessment.risks: contract: refusal code, Why/Fix text and exit-listener cleanup must stay identical; dependency: Node stdlib only; concurrency: the child-gone flag is per backend instance; state: no tuning settings, prompts or suite hashes change
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first timing test plus all 35 external-engine tests, then npm test and project gates

checkpoints.description: [2/2] DELIVERED: failed engine spawn 5154ms -> 143ms; full suite 17.4s -> 12.8s; 1104 tests pass, strict gates 4/4
Task 'tuning-test-speed' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Cache shipped presets by exact file stamp so /api/recommendations stops re-reading and re-parsing them per request

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; measured readShippedPresets at 1.52ms per call and /api/recommendations at 5.12ms with 8 models
impact_assessment.benefits: Exact-stamp cache: no stale presets after a file edit, but no repeated 135KB read+parse on unchanged files
impact_assessment.risks: contract: returned recipe objects and skip-invalid behavior must stay identical; dependency: Node fs only; concurrency: cache is keyed by directory; state: no tuning settings, prompts or suite hashes change
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first test with a read counter plus invalidation test on file change, then npm test and gates

checkpoints.description: [2/2] DELIVERED: readShippedPresets 1.52ms -> 0.27ms; /api/recommendations 5.12ms -> 4.52ms; exact-stamp invalidation tested; 1106 tests pass, strict gates 4/4
Task 'preset-cache-speed-1122' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Run independent multistep chains concurrently in the test runner; no assertion or sandbox change

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; TAP profile showed multistep/sandbox tests at 0.6-1.0s each because child processes ran one after another
impact_assessment.benefits: Shorter test wall time without weakening the sandbox or changing any check
impact_assessment.risks: contract: every test keeps its assertions; dependency: Node test runner option only; concurrency: chains use independent sandboxed children and read-only chain data; state: no app, tuning or suite hash change
impact_assessment.mitigation: measured before/after on the same file, full npm test, strict gates; revert if the file gets slower

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Rejected and reversed: concurrent multistep tests sped one file (3.44s -> 2.87s) but made the full gate flaky/slower (48s, timing assertion failed), so the option was removed; 4/4 gates green after revert
